items.text: OpenAI's first Jony Ive-designed device is reportedly a hockey-puck-sized smart speaker priced between $300 and $400, according to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman.
items.text_zh: 据彭博社古尔曼爆料，OpenAI 与 Jony Ive 合作的首款硬件是一台冰球大小的智能音箱，售价预计在 300 至 400 美元之间。

items.text: OpenAI put Codex Security Review into research preview, having the agent inspect GitHub pull requests for security issues using full repository context.
items.text_zh: OpenAI 推出研究预览版 Codex Security Review，让智能体结合完整仓库上下文审查 GitHub 拉取请求中的安全问题。

items.text: ChatGPT can now call Adobe Photoshop and Lightroom directly, letting users retouch and design inside the chat without leaving the conversation.
items.text_zh: ChatGPT 现已可直接调用 Adobe Photoshop 与 Lightroom，用户无需离开对话即可完成修图与设计。

items.text: Moonshot AI's open-weight Kimi K3 became generally available in GitHub Copilot for agentic coding, hosted by Fireworks AI.
items.text_zh: 月之暗面开源权重模型 Kimi K3 正式在 GitHub Copilot 上线，面向智能体编程场景，由 Fireworks AI 提供托管。

items.text: Perplexity made GPT-5.6 Terra the default model for all Perplexity Computer subagents, saying it scores eleven points above Sonnet on WANDR.
items.text_zh: Perplexity 将 GPT-5.6 Terra 设为 Perplexity Computer 全部子智能体的默认模型，称其在 WANDR 上比 Sonnet 高出 11 分。

items.text: Cursor detailed its Router, which classifies requests and routes them across Grok 4.5, GPT-5.6 Sol and Opus 5 to cut latency and cost.
items.text_zh: Cursor 披露其 Router 工作原理：对请求分类后在 Grok 4.5、GPT-5.6 Sol 与 Opus 5 之间智能路由，以降低延迟和成本。

items.text: ElevenLabs shipped Dubbing v2 on its API, adding regional accent accuracy and letting enterprises bring their own transcripts and regenerate only edited segments.
items.text_zh: ElevenLabs 发布 API 版 Dubbing v2，提升地区口音还原度，并支持企业自带转录文本、仅重新生成被修改的片段。

items.text: Luma Labs added MiniMax H3 to Luma Agents, generating up to 15 seconds of 2K video with native stereo sound.
items.text_zh: Luma Labs 将 MiniMax H3 接入 Luma Agents，可生成最长 15 秒、2K 分辨率并自带立体声音频的视频。

items.text: Meshy upgraded Multi-View Image to 3D so textures are now generated from multiple reference views rather than a single one.
items.text_zh: Meshy 升级多视角图生 3D 功能，纹理现可基于多张参考视图生成，而非仅依赖单一视角。

items.text: Shanghai AI Lab open-sourced Mobius, an architecture it frames as upgrading knowledge connectivity the way Transformers upgraded token connectivity over RNNs.
items.text_zh: 上海人工智能实验室开源 Mobius 架构，称其对"知识连接性"的升级，类比于 Transformer 相对 RNN 在 token 连接性上的跃迁。

items.text: Unsloth released DSpark, which makes DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 GGUF builds generate roughly 1.4 to 2 times faster locally with no accuracy change.
items.text_zh: Unsloth 发布 DSpark，让 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 的 GGUF 版本在本地推理速度提升约 1.4 至 2 倍，且精度不变。

items.text: A community effort pointed coding agents at ICML 2026, with over 1,200 people reproducing more than 2,000 papers in the largest conference reproducibility audit yet.
items.text_zh: 一场社区行动把编程智能体对准 ICML 2026，1200 多人复现了逾 2000 篇论文，成为迄今规模最大的会议可复现性审计。

items.text: Genspark brought its open-source GenOffice suite to Linux, matching the existing Mac and Windows builds.
items.text_zh: Genspark 将开源办公套件 GenOffice 移植到 Linux，与已有的 Mac、Windows 版本保持一致。

items.text: Naïve raised $28.5 million to automate the administrative grunt work of incorporating and running a company.
items.text_zh: Naïve 融资 2850 万美元，用自动化处理公司注册与日常运营中的繁琐行政事务。

items.text: Liquid AI released LFM2.5-2.6B, an on-device agentic model with 128K context, tool calling and open weights in native, GGUF, MLX and ONNX formats.
items.text_zh: Liquid AI 发布端侧智能体模型 LFM2.5-2.6B，支持 128K 上下文与工具调用，权重开放并提供原生、GGUF、MLX、ONNX 四种格式。

items.text: Microsoft open-sourced code-testing-generator, a polyglot unit-test agent that completed 92.1% of 152 internal tasks versus 78.9% for stock GitHub Copilot.
items.text_zh: 微软开源多语言单元测试智能体 code-testing-generator，在 152 项内部任务中完成率达 92.1%，而原版 GitHub Copilot 为 78.9%。

items.text: Alibaba opened public beta of video model Wan3.0, which generates 30-second clips and accepts docs, spreadsheets, slides and PDFs as input.
items.text_zh: 阿里视频大模型 Wan3.0 开启公测，单段可生成 30 秒视频，并支持文档、表格、PPT、PDF 作为输入素材。

items.text: Ant Group open-sourced Avernet under Apache 2.0, a multi-agent collaboration layer already deployed across 12 internal business units with over 90% task completion.
items.text_zh: 蚂蚁集团以 Apache 2.0 协议开源多智能体协作基础设施 Avernet，已在内部 12 个核心业务线落地，任务完成率持续超过 90%。

items.text: MiniMax said the community built a distillation LoRA for its open-weight H3 video model four days after release, cutting sampling from 20 steps to 4–8.
items.text_zh: MiniMax 表示开源 H3 视频模型放出权重四天后，社区就做出蒸馏 LoRA，把采样步数从 20 步压到 4—8 步。

items.text: Hailuo AI demoed redubbing existing clips into another language or tone while preserving the original speaker's exact voice and natural speech cadence.
items.text_zh: 海螺 AI 演示视频重配音功能，可将已有片段换成另一种语言或语气，同时保留原说话人的音色与自然语速。

items.text: MiniMax will livestream with ComfyUI on August 7 to stress-test H3, showing open weights, native stereo audio and clips up to 2K resolution and 15 seconds.
items.text_zh: MiniMax 将于 8 月 7 日联合 ComfyUI 直播实测 H3，展示开源权重、原生立体声音频以及最高 2K、15 秒的视频生成。

items.text: Together AI benchmarked DeepSeek-V4 Flash-0731 against GPT-5.6 Luna on DeepSWE software engineering tasks, finding it delivers 80% of Luna's performance far more cheaply.
items.text_zh: Together AI 用 DeepSWE 软件工程任务对比 DeepSeek-V4 Flash-0731 与 GPT-5.6 Luna，称前者以极低成本达到后者 80% 的表现。

items.text: Cloudflare launched temporary accounts so agents can deploy Workers instantly via wrangler deploy --temporary, with deployments expiring in 60 minutes unless a human claims them.
items.text_zh: Cloudflare 推出临时账户，智能体可用 wrangler deploy --temporary 直接部署 Worker，部署 60 分钟后若无人认领即自动失效。

items.text: Apple's bug bounty review team went offline under a flood of AI-generated reports, imposing submission caps and a 30-day cooldown from August 2.
items.text_zh: 在 AI 批量生成的漏洞报告轰炸下，苹果漏洞赏金审核团队已下线，并自 8 月 2 日起实施提交数量限制和 30 天冷却期。

items.text: Replit said a live session where 14,075 people built apps together set a Guinness World Record for the largest AI video lesson.
items.text_zh: Replit 宣布一场 14075 人同时在线共建应用的直播课，创下"最大规模 AI 视频课程"吉尼斯世界纪录。

items.text: Genspark argued that enterprise AI bills keep climbing even as per-unit intelligence got roughly ten times cheaper this year, because agents moved into production.
items.text_zh: Genspark 指出，今年单位智能成本降了约十倍，但企业 AI 账单仍在上涨，原因是智能体大规模进入生产环境。

items.text: South Korea's Mobilint launched the MLD-R1, a USB-form AI accelerator delivering 10 TOPS of INT8 compute for edge inference.
items.text_zh: 韩国 Mobilint 推出 USB 形态 AI 加速器 MLD-R1，内置 10TOPS INT8 算力，面向边缘侧推理场景。

items.text: A leaked new Microsoft Copilot icon shows the assistant moving to a flatter, simpler design.
items.text_zh: 微软 Copilot 新版图标泄露，助手标识趋向扁平化、设计更为简洁。
